commit.message:
Initial commit: Enterprise Search Frontend with Policy Dashboard

Features implemented:
- ✅ Dynamic Policy Management System with search, filters, and real-time updates
- ✅ Comprehensive Reports Dashboard with drag-and-drop widgets and export options
- ✅ Enhanced Knowledge Base with integration support for multiple platforms
- ✅ Modern UI/UX with minimalistic design and micro-interactions
- ✅ Role-based navigation and permissions system
- ✅ Real-time compliance monitoring and risk assessment
- ✅ Advanced state management with Zustand (695+ lines policy store)
- ✅ Full TypeScript implementation with Next.js 15
- ✅ Responsive design with Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion
- ✅ File upload and management with multiple format support
- ✅ Integration icons and platform connectivity (fixed SVG display issues)
- ✅ Automated report generation and scheduling
- ✅ Export capabilities (PDF, Excel, CSV, PNG, JSON)

Technical Stack:
- Next.js 15 with App Router and Turbopack
- TypeScript with strict mode
- Tailwind CSS for styling
- Framer Motion for animations
- Zustand for state management
- Lucide React for icons
- Recharts for data visualization
- Radix UI primitives for components
